filterGuide.prompt.description: Take a quick tour of this catalogue’s filters, or start using them now. We’ll remember your choice for this catalogue.
filterGuide.prompt.title: Would you like a filter guide?
filterGuide.steps.actions.description: Reset clears the choices in this panel. Apply updates the catalogue and closes the panel. Closing without applying keeps your previous filters.
filterGuide.steps.actions.title: Reset or apply
filterGuide.steps.appearance.description: Select card attributes to include. Leave them unselected to include all attributes.
filterGuide.steps.appearance.title: Attributes
filterGuide.steps.cardType.description: Select the card types you want to include. Leave them unselected to include all types.
filterGuide.steps.cardType.title: Card types
filterGuide.steps.cardUnit.description: Select units to include. Selecting Virtual Singer makes a separate support-unit filter available.
filterGuide.steps.cardUnit.title: Units
filterGuide.steps.category.description: Choose song categories to include. Available categories appear here once loaded.
filterGuide.steps.category.title: Song categories
filterGuide.steps.characters.description: Select the characters whose cards you want to include.
filterGuide.steps.characters.title: Characters
filterGuide.steps.charts.description: Enable this option to show only songs with an APPEND chart.
filterGuide.steps.charts.title: APPEND charts
filterGuide.steps.credits.description: Filter by composer, arranger, or lyricist. Suggestions appear when available.
filterGuide.steps.credits.title: Song credits
filterGuide.steps.extras.description: Enable this option to show only cards with a 3D MV cut-in.
filterGuide.steps.extras.title: 3D MV cut-ins
filterGuide.steps.id.description: Enter a virtual live ID to find that live directly, or leave it empty to browse.
filterGuide.steps.id.title: Find a specific live
filterGuide.steps.level.description: Enter a chart level to narrow the song list. Suggestions appear when available.
filterGuide.steps.level.title: Chart level
filterGuide.steps.liveType.description: Select the types of live you want to include. Leave them unselected to include all types.
filterGuide.steps.liveType.title: Virtual live types
filterGuide.steps.name.description: Enter part of a name to narrow the catalogue. Leave it empty to include all names.
filterGuide.steps.name.title: Search by name
filterGuide.steps.rarity.description: Choose the rarities you want to include. Leave them unselected to include all rarities.
filterGuide.steps.rarity.title: Rarity
filterGuide.steps.skills.description: Select the skill types you want to include.
filterGuide.steps.skills.title: Skills
filterGuide.steps.supportUnit.descriptio: Narrow Virtual Singer cards by their support unit. This filter is available when Virtual Singer is selected.
filterGuide.steps.supportUnit.title: Support units
filterGuide.steps.tags.description: Choose unit tags to narrow the song list, or All to include every unit tag.
filterGuide.steps.tags.title: Unit tags
filterGuide.steps.vocals.description: Select characters to find songs featuring their vocals.
filterGuide.steps.vocals.title: Vocal characters
filterGuide.title: Filter guide
